blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY — Albay suspended classes in public and private schools this week as health authorities stepped up efforts to contain a surge in dengue cases, which prompted the province to declare a state of calamity. Gov. Noel Rosal ordered the suspension to give schools and local governments time to conduct cleanup drives and implement other anti-dengue measures. As of September 10, the dengue case tally was 1,785, with 14 deaths recorded from January 1 to September 8. Public elementary and secondary schools remained closed Monday and Tuesday for the scheduled wellness break, followed by a provincewide class suspension from Wednesday […]...
